title: Health URLs that need no token
description: The recorded exemption from authentication: the URLs a load balancer may call without a token, and what they may reveal. Written in this repository because FINOS publishes no control requirement for an MCP server (#270). The first three properties are the ones the CALM control-requirement meta-schema requires of every control.

control-id.description: The key of this control in the architecture file.

paths.description: Every path this control opens. The sign-in metadata document is the one other path served without a token; its exemption is declared on its interface, not here (#324).

response-body.description: The answer is a status code alone, so the URLs reveal nothing but up or not.

exemption-recorded-in.description: Where the exemption and its reasoning are written down.
